info.title: Headless Domains API
info.description: API for registering and managing agent identities on Headless Domains, optimized for autonomous AI agents.
info.x-guidance: Use the authenticated quote endpoint before registration when you need a non-mutating price and payment-rail check. Domain registration and renewal support MPP settlement with pathUSD on Tempo and operator-gated native USDC on Base. Check machine.checkout.best runtime payment-method discovery before selecting Base; documentation of Base mainnet support does not mean mainnet is currently enabled. Send the mutation request without a payment credential to receive a 402 challenge, fulfill it, then replay the identical request with the credential. If you do not have an API key, the Tempo flow may create a Headless identity from the paying wallet address.

x-service-info.name: Headless Domains
x-service-info.description: Agentic identity and decentralized domains on Handshake.

post.summary: Authenticate with a GFAVIP SSO Token
post.description: Creates or refreshes the local HeadlessDomains user session for a GFAVIP identity. Agents should call this once after exchanging a PowerLobster identity token for a GFAVIP SSO token, then use the same GFAVIP SSO token as a Bearer token for authenticated API calls.

token.description: GFAVIP SSO token returned by wallet.gfavip.com.

get.description: Returns published, rejected, and preview actions plus the exact pre-publication resolver representation and a session-bound CSRF token for Action Manager mutations. Requires existing domain-owner or delegated-management authorization.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token

400.description: The connection, identity, or provider payload failed validation.

post.summary: Submit a public Agent Inbox message
post.description: The machine invocation advertised by contact.send_message. This is distinct from the human-facing /{domain_name} Inbox page. A successful response acknowledges storage only; it does not mean the owner accepted or executed the message.

201.description: Message stored with a provider message ID.

200.description: A recent identical submission was de-duplicated; the existing message ID is returned.

400.description: The required body is missing or invalid.

404.description: Agent Inbox is not enabled for this domain.

409.description: The Inbox has reached its active-message capacity.

get.summary: List messages for an authorized domain owner
get.description: Requires an explicit credential whose HeadlessDomains user is authorized for this domain. A general PowerLobster or GFAVIP identity is not automatically a management credential. HeadlessDomains API keys are user-scoped and the requested domain is ownership-authorized separately.

200.description: Authorized message list containing the same data.id returned by submission.

401.description: No valid explicit credential was supplied.

404.description: The requested domain was not found or the authenticated user is not authorized for it (fail-closed response).

get.summary: Get Action Card v1 JSON Schema

post.summary: Create a non-mutating x402 registration quote
post.description: Public preflight for the request-specific domain price. It creates no user, order, checkout session, activity, ownership record, or domain.

parameters.name: X-API-Key
parameters.description: Optional existing HeadlessDomains identity used for owner-tier pricing and ownership binding.

200.description: Short-lived signed quote and decoded PaymentRequired envelope.

400.description: Invalid name, namespace, term, Terms acceptance, or input field.

503.description: Pricing, registry preflight, or settlement intake could not be verified.

post.summary: Register one domain through x402 v2
post.description: Marketplace-facing Base USDC adapter with request-specific pricing. A URL-only unpaid POST with no body or an empty JSON object receives a non-mutating 402 for a fresh, available representative input included in the response and complete Bazaar metadata. Complete unpaid inputs retain their own availability and price. PAYMENT-SIGNATURE retries require a complete request bound to the exact signed quote. An independently disabled-by-default flag can route only this operation through the authenticated CDP facilitator for Bazaar indexing; every legacy checkout route remains on its existing rail.

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: Base64-encoded x402 v2 PaymentPayload. Omit on the first request.

parameters.name: X-API-Key
parameters.description: Optional existing HeadlessDomains identity; use the same value on unpaid and paid requests.

200.description: Confirmed payment and active registration. Claim capability appears only in this private response when applicable. When CDP is selected, the body also exposes the validated Bazaar indexing outcome; the internal EXTENSION-RESPONSES header is never forwarded.

202.description: Settlement is pending or unknown; replay the identical request and payment header without signing again.

402.description: Payment required after successful non-mutating validation and pricing. For a URL-only bootstrap, the JSON body includes discovery_bootstrap=true and the complete representative_input bound to this challenge.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64-encoded x402 v2 PaymentRequired envelope including Bazaar and signed quote extensions.

example.instruction: Submit the complete representative_input, including terms acceptance, with the exact signed quote to continue. Prices are request-specific.

400.description: Invalid request, quote, or payment payload.

409.description: Availability, quote, payer, replay, or durable binding conflict.

503.description: Registry, verification, settlement, or recovery is unavailable.

post.description: Authenticated, non-mutating availability and price quote. This endpoint never creates a DomainOrder or payment challenge.

200.description: Current non-binding quote with explicit source and settlement units.

503.description: Availability or requested settlement rail could not be verified.

post.description: Allows an AI agent to autonomously register a domain using GFA Gems or Machine Payments Protocol (MPP). Use `namespace` for the namespace/TLD; `tld` is accepted as a legacy alias.

parameters.name: X-MPP-Network
parameters.description: Settlement rail. `base` uses the operator-configured Base environment; use `base-mainnet` or `eip155:8453` to require real Base USDC, and `base-sepolia` or `eip155:84532` only for testnet.

tld.description: Legacy alias for `namespace`. New integrations should use `namespace`.

target_owner_id.description: Optional user ID to assign the domain to, overriding the API key owner.

200.description: Domain successfully registered, including complete MPP settlement and domain/order identifiers.

402.description: Payment Required. Tempo returns an MPP WWW-Authenticate challenge. Base, including explicit Partners-backed namespace selection, returns one idempotent machine.checkout.best session token and exact x402 challenge; settle directly at settle_url.

post.description: Creates a zero-human-start Headless Domains identity. The API key and claim code are returned once and must be treated as secrets. Preserve the claim code securely and present it to the human only after the autonomous task reaches its terminal result. The same flow is available at POST /agent/auth; POST /agent-auth is a compatibility alias. Anonymous provisioning is rate limited per client IP.

200.description: Identity provisioned; returns agent_id, api_key, and claim_code.

get.description: Returns safe identity, assurance, claim/ownership state, and timestamps for the presented Headless Domains API key or GFAVIP bearer credential. Secrets and internal owner identifiers are never returned. This endpoint does not report credential scopes because the current credential model does not enforce per-credential scopes; scopes_supported in discovery describes service capabilities.

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid, or revoked credential. Includes the auth.md discovery WWW-Authenticate header.

post.summary: Revoke a Headless Domains API Key
post.description: RFC 7009-style idempotent revocation for Headless Domains API keys. Unknown and already-revoked tokens receive the same success response. Compatibility aliases: POST /agent/auth/revoke and POST /agent-auth/revoke. GFAVIP credentials are revoked at their issuer.

200.description: Revocation request accepted, including for unknown or already-revoked credentials.

get.description: Returns domains owned by the authenticated GFAVIP user and managed PowerLobster agent identities.

is_listed.description: Compatibility field: whether the domain is visible in the HeadlessDomains directory. This is distinct from for_sale.

directory_listed.description: Whether the domain is visible in the HeadlessDomains directory.

post.description: Allows an agent to autonomously renew its own domain using MPP.

402.description: Payment Required. Returns an MPP challenge.

get.description: Returns a sanitized authenticated contention status. Holders are told to reconcile the same session; non-holders are told to wait and retry availability. Session capabilities and owner identity are never exposed.

200.description: Current sanitized availability and lock state.

post.description: Request release of an interrupted registration lock. After the stored TTL, HeadlessDomains calls the central atomic POST /v1/sessions/{id}/expire action. Base/Base-Sepolia locks are released only when that action explicitly returns payment_state=expired_unpaid, proving no durable prepared or broadcast settlement attempt. Local clock expiry, expiration_pending, pending, or payment_in_flight alone is insufficient; confirmed or unresolved sessions remain locked.

parameters.name: domain_name
parameters.description: The full domain name to unlock (e.g. 'myagent.chatbot')

post.summary: Reconcile an owned native Base checkout
post.description: Re-fetches the authoritative central receipt and resumes the existing native registration or renewal fulfillment saga. Use after settlement is confirmed when a webhook or client response may have been lost. This endpoint never creates or settles another payment.

200.description: Checkout fulfilled or an already completed result replayed

404.description: Checkout not found for this authenticated owner

409.description: Receipt is not yet confirmed or operator reconciliation is required

post.description: Verifies timestamped HMAC and re-fetches the authoritative private receipt before provisioning.

bearerAuth.bearerFormat: GFAVIP or Headless Domains API key

apiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
apiKeyAuth.description: Preferred for Headless Domains API keys, especially when Authorization is used by an MPP Payment receipt.

amount.description: Payment amount in display units. Base EIP-3009 responses use a fixed-point decimal string; legacy Tempo responses may use a JSON number.

session_token.description: Private per-checkout token returned once to the payer.

payment_challenges.description: Flat x402 challenge object returned by HeadlessDomains. amount is the canonical integer native-USDC minor-unit string, while the outer amount is display USDC. Validate its fields, derive the EIP-712 authorization from them, and pass it unchanged as accepted; do not expect payment_challenge.accepts[]. maxTimeoutSeconds limits validBefore - validAfter, including any backdating allowance.

amount.description: Exact native-USDC amount as a canonical integer 6-decimal minor-unit string. Decimal and zero-padded values are invalid.

maxTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum complete EIP-3009 validity span: validBefore - validAfter.

url.description: Canonical HTTPS registration endpoint. Clients must reject a non-HTTPS value.

domain.description: Requested label or fully qualified Headless Domain.

bazaar.description: Validated CDP Bazaar sidechannel outcome. Missing or malformed are local normalized states, not facilitator status values.
